scripts.build: npm run build:verifier && npm run build:browser
scripts.build:verifier: esbuild scripts/forge-verify.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node22 --outfile=public/forge-verify.mjs --legal-comments=eof --banner:js="import { createRequire as forgeRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = forgeRequire(import.meta.url);"
scripts.typecheck: wrangler types --strict-vars=false >/dev/null && tsc --noEmit && tsc --noEmit -p authority && tsc --noEmit -p scripts && tsc --noEmit -p browser && tsc --noEmit -p e2e
scripts.test: vitest run -c vitest.authority.config.ts && vitest run && node scripts/check-production-bundle.ts
